context_for_next_testing_agent: Custom fields feature fully tested and working. Backend APIs: POST /api/admin/form-config/custom-field (create), DELETE /api/admin/form-config/custom-field/{key} (delete), GET /api/public/form-config (public, no auth), GET /api/admin/form-config/fields (admin), PUT /api/admin/form-config/fields (update), POST /api/admin/form-config/reset (reset to defaults). Frontend: FormManagementPage shows all fields by step with 'Novo Campo' button, dialog has label/type/step/placeholder/hint/required inputs, options editor for select/checkbox types. PublicClientForm renders custom fields under 'CAMPOS ADICIONAIS' section with dashed green border. Custom field created during testing: custom_2d1066c9 'País de residência fiscal' (select, step 1).
